_readme: runs/<BRANCH>/<tier>-<env>/tests/y/<run>/y-test-inputs.json - read by scripts/fe_reconcile.py. Every <...> is an OPEN point the skill asks.
gbo_environment: <ask - the GBO environment holding the branch's data for the same dates>
box_environment: <ask - the BOX environment (NY_SCH: DGBOUS DEV or IGBOUSIB PRE Paralelo)>
trades: <ask - the trades' values in the key column (the same on both sides)>
gbo_filter: <optional - an extra SQL condition on the GBO tables>
box_filter: <optional - an extra SQL condition on the BOX tables>
